extraction.name: TravelPlanner
extraction.description: A benchmark for real-world planning with language agents, focusing on travel planning. It provides a rich sandbox environment with nearly four million data records, six tools for accessing data, and 1,225 meticulously curated planning intents and reference plans.
extraction.creator: Jian Xie, Kai Zhang, Jiangjie Chen, Tinghui Zhu, Renze Lou, Yuandong Tian, Yanghua Xiao, Yu Su
extraction.publisher: Fudan University, The Ohio State University, The Pennsylvania State University, Meta AI
extraction.rai:dataCollection: The dataset was constructed by creating a static and closed sandbox environment. Data was crawled from the Internet and sourced from public datasets (Kaggle, Google APIs). Queries were synthesized using heuristic rules and GPT-4, and plans were manually annotated by human annotators.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: Data was sourced from publicly available Internet data, including the Kaggle Flight Status Prediction dataset, Kaggle Zomato Restaurants Dataset, Kaggle Airbnb Open Data Dataset, Google Distance Matrix API, and Google Places API.
extraction.rai:dataManipulationProtocol: Original data was modified by adding, deleting, and altering certain keys and values to suit requirements and avoid data contamination. Prices were generated by multiplying distance by random factors. Cuisines and room rules were randomly assigned to align with constraint requirements.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: The dataset was divided into training, validation, and test sets. Queries were categorized by duration (3, 5, or 7 days) and number of hard constraints (Easy, Medium, Hard). Budgets were re-calibrated using costs from human-annotated plans to ensure feasibility.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: 20 graduate students were invited to meticulously annotate plans for synthesized queries. Annotators were paid an average of $0.80 per plan. The process took an average of 12 minutes per plan. Authors performed a detailed review and quality check of every query and plan.
extraction.rai:dataSocialImpact: The benchmark aims to provide a challenging testbed for future language agents to improve planning capabilities. It highlights current limitations of LLMs in complex planning and tool use, encouraging research into more sophisticated planning strategies and human-level cognitive capabilities.
extraction.rai:dataBiases: The evaluation criteria for commonsense constraints are based on the authors' consensus, acknowledging that definitions of commonsense may vary. The data is derived from publicly available sources, which may reflect existing biases in those sources.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: The benchmark focuses on travel planning, which may not generalize to all planning domains. The sandbox environment is static, which may not fully capture the dynamics of the real world. Current language agents struggle significantly with the complexity of the tasks, indicating a gap in current AI capabilities.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Training, Testing, Validation, Fine Tuning of language agents for planning and tool-use tasks.
